definition: How the spread of price changes grows with the lag they span, over the last window prices: the slope of the log standard deviation of lagged differences on the log lag.
boundaries: QuantConnect LEAN's estimator on raw prices with lags 2 to max_lag, not the rescaled range; the mean of each lag's differences is taken out, so a steady drift alone does not read as trend. It needs about 1,000 points to mean anything, so the window starts there, and bid-ask bounce on short bars pushes it down.
recognition: About 0.5 for a random walk, above 0.5 when moves persist, below 0.5 when they revert.
